newsitem.title: UK: Elf creates new UK refining JV with Gulf, Murphy.
newsitem.headline: Elf creates new UK refining JV with Gulf, Murphy.

text.p: Elf U.K. said on Wednesday it has signed a memorandum of understanding with Chevron Corp subsidiary Gulf Oil and Murphy Petroleum to merge their U.K. refining and marketing operations in a new joint venture which will save 50 million sterling ($82.63 million) a year.
The new company will consolidate refining interests in Milford Haven in south Wales by ceasing crude processing at the 115,000 barrels per day (bpd) Gulf refinery in Texaco.
Subject to final agreement which is expected early next year, Elf and Gulf will each hold 41.25 percent of the new company with Murphy Oil Corp (Murco) holding the remaining 17.50 percent.

Elf said the merger, which will create a retail network of about 1,500 service stations with an estimated eight percent share of the U.K. fuels market, would provide major benefits of scale and improved efficiencies and strengthen Milford Haven prospects as a refining centre.

"The difficulties currently faced by the oil refining and marketing industry are well known. We recognise today that, for all three of us, this merger is the best option for a promising future as a new force to be reckoned with in the U.K. market," said Christian Cleret, managing director of Elf Oil U.K. Ltd. ($1=.6051 Sterling)
